title: Enforce repository-owned Conventional Commits
summary: Replace the local-only commit regex with one Rust policy enforced by the commit hook, pull-request and main history ranges, pull-request titles, and the fail-closed CI aggregate.
scope: Raw Git commit-object and range validation
GitHub pull-request title and history enforcement

risk.failure_mode: An incorrect parser, event range, or aggregate dependency can block valid contributions or allow nonconforming history onto main.
risk.rollback: Revert the M0-013 implementation and documentation commits together to restore the previous local-only hook and seven-gate CI topology.

compatibility.detail: No emulator runtime, media, API, configuration, or firmware behavior changes.

security.detail: Hosted validation removes the local --no-verify bypass from the protected-branch promotion path and reads only bounded repository commit metadata.

tests.proves: Supported Conventional Commit forms pass and malformed, WIP, autosquash, unsafe, oversized, and ambiguous inputs fail closed.
The repository-owned parser validates real raw commit objects over the selected local or hosted event range.
Commit policy composes with lockfile, governance, host, compatibility, supply-chain, portable, and firmware gates.
